meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动将实验室数据集成到 Benchling
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Benchling 中手动操作数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data integration with Benchling.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Benchling data manually.

howto.what: Claude 会通过 Python SDK 操作 Benchling:创建或更新 DNA/RNA/蛋白质等序列实体,管理样本容器,写实验记录,发起工作流任务,并用 SQL 查询数据仓库。
howto.when: 当你提出要自动化 Benchling 上的实验数据,比如管理序列、库存、实验记录或工作流时触发。

say.text: 把容器 cont_abc123 转移到 box_xyz789
say.note: Claude 会执行库存转移操作。

say.text: 查一下数据仓库里上周录入的 DNA 序列有多少
say.note: Claude 会用 SQL 查询数据仓库。

howto.what_en: Claude will operate Benchling via its Python SDK: create/update DNA, RNA, protein and other entities, manage inventory and containers, create ELN entries, run workflow tasks, and query the Data Warehouse with SQL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to automate Benchling lab data, such as managing sequences, inventory, notebook entries, workflows, or querying the Data Warehouse using the benchling-sdk or v2 API.

say_en.text: Create a circular plasmid named pTest with sequence ATCG using benchling-sdk
say_en.note: Claude will create a DNA sequence and return the result.
Claude will perform the inventory transfer.

say_en.text: Count DNA sequences entered in the Data Warehouse last week
say_en.note: Claude will query the Data Warehouse with SQL.
